one_month_reasoning: The one scheduled event in the window is the Q3 2026 results and call on 2026-10-29 [3]. Materion has raised guidance twice this year, has a record backlog up about 30% and doubled space orders [1,2], so another beat and raise is more likely than not. But expectations are high. The stock ran about 65% from roughly $189 on 2026-07-29 [4] and rose 5.8% on Oct 1 and 9.6% on Oct 2 to all-time highs [10,11], so it is extended. Management also flagged that Q2 one-off items ($2-3M) and the 32% Electronic Materials margin may not repeat [2], and Q2 sales beat by about 25% before the stock gapped up 25%. Momentum and a likely beat point up; a short-term reversal after a two-day spike points down. These roughly cancel. I centre the distribution at about $311, close to the last close, with a lognormal sigma of about 0.17. That is the monthly vol of 59%/3.5, and the earnings event is what keeps it from shrinking. There is no directional tilt.

fair_value.method: Blend of two methods at 50/50. P/E: 2028E EPS of $9.9 x 28x = $277. EV/EBITDA: NTM EBITDA as of Oct-2027 of $345M x 19x, minus about $330M net debt, over 21.1M shares = $295. Blended fair value is about $286, below the $312 price.

inputs_detail.derivation: Consensus is about $8.44, implied by GuruFocus forward P/E of 33.8x at $285.14 [10]. I nudge it up toward the history of beats (Q2: $1.90 vs $1.52 est) and ~20% projected EPS growth [11].
Backlog +30%, defense RFQs over $500M and a customer-funded beryllium expansion [1,2] support mid-teens growth. I haircut from ~20% consensus growth [11] for cyclicality and margin normalisation.

Sits near the 5-year median P/E of 28.8x [10]. It is below the current ~37x forward multiple because the strategic-materials/space premium is likely to fade partly. Independent narratives put fair value at $274 (Simply Wall St most-followed) [13] and GF Value at $153 [10].

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: NTM EBITDA as of Oct-2027 $345M x 19x = EV $6.56B; less net debt ~$0.33B; / 21.1M diluted shares

inputs_detail.derivation: FY2026 run-rate is about $265M (Q2 $71.8M x ~3.7). I grow it about 14%/yr with mid-teens VA-sales growth and a flat-to-up margin [1,2]. Management flagged Q2 mix and one-offs as not fully repeatable [2].
Today's EV of about $7.0B ($312 x 21.1M + $421M net debt) on 2026E EBITDA is about 26x [1]. I assume partial mean reversion toward the historical P/E median [10], applying 19x to NTM.
Reported $440.7M debt less $20.0M cash [1]. Paid down from FCF (Q2 FCF $59M [1]) net of capex and dividends.

bear.story: Semis/AI or space orders pause after the 2026 pull-forward, and EM margins normalise from 32%. 2027 EPS comes in around $7.5 and the multiple falls back to ~22x as the SpaceX-supply-chain theme cools and insider selling continues.

base.story: Mid-teens growth continues and 2027 EPS is about $8.6. The multiple compresses from ~37x to ~30x NTM, so price is roughly flat with fair value in the high $200s to low $300s.

bull.story: Defense beryllium capacity, space orders (doubling), fusion (CFS beryllium fluoride) and AI chips drive 2027 EPS above $9.5 and a 2028 path to $12. The scarce-strategic-metal premium holds at ~38x.

thesis_break_reason: $190 is where the stock sat just before the Q2 beat (~$189 on 2026-07-29) [4], about 22x 2027E EPS. Trading back there would mean the 2026 re-rating has fully unwound. That would most likely come from a guidance cut, a reversal in backlog or space/semis orders, or loss of a key program rather than ordinary volatility.

How much of the ~37x forward multiple is a SpaceX/strategic-materials theme premium that can deflate

The precious-metal pass-through inflates net sales; value-added sales growth is the real metric

reasoning: Materion beat and raised in Q2 2026: adj EPS $1.90, FY26 guidance $6.80-7.20, backlog +30%, space orders doubled, $500M+ in defense RFQs [1,2]. The stock re-rated from ~$189 in late July to $312, up 16% in the last two sessions alone [4,10,11]. Alternative-lane evidence shows retail/newsletter enthusiasm built around a SpaceX-supply-chain/beryllium-monopoly narrative after the record SpaceX IPO in June 2026 [5,6,7,8,9]. Those pieces give no data on SpaceX revenue share [5], and the main disclosed space award is only ~$15M [2], so the theme looks ahead of fundamentals. StockTwits is still a small crowd (~519 watchers) but euphoric ('holy crap' ATH posts) [4]. GuruFocus flags 66x trailing P/E vs a 28.8x median [10], and sell-side targets average ~$310, around the price [11]. Insiders are net sellers [10,11]. My fair value of ~$286 (P/E and EV/EBITDA blended) sits below the price, while momentum and estimate-revision tailwinds argue against a hard fade. I set the 12-month median at ~$295, about 5% below spot. Dispersion is a lognormal sigma of ~0.48, below the 59% realised vol because that included a one-off re-rating, but above a typical large-cap. Implied mean is ~$330, scenario-weighted mean ~$308. Research was limited: X/Twitter and Reddit were not reachable (Reddit returned 403; X redirects block fetch), and USGS PDF parsing failed. Prediction-market data covers SpaceX IPO timing only, with no market on Materion itself. No option data was used.
